title: NetworkMachineRolesPut
description: network.machine-roles-put@1: the roles the owner gives a machine (PUT /api/v1/machines/:id/roles, capability machines.manage). The whole set, not a change: what is not named is turned off. Every id must be in the catalogue (network.machine-roles@1); an unknown role is refused and nothing is changed.

roles.description: The machine's roles after the change. An empty array turns every role off.
